about: Jaihind Industries Ltd (formerly Jaihind Synthetics Ltd) is a BSE-listed micro-company with legacy textile objects but FY25 accounts showing only commission income and no operating revenue, PPE or inventory. In May 2026 it incorporated 78%-owned healthcare/pharmaceutical subsidiary Wellness & Medicial Oasisz Pvt Ltd, then pre-operations. [1] [2] [3]
